prompts.outpost:
Use case: precise-object-edit / game background.
Image1 is our approved ORIGINAL game UI mockup, supplied only for its world art and layout style. Create the production-ready MAP BACKGROUND ONLY for chapter1, FRONTIER OUTPOST, as a full bleed tall portrait illustration with width:height = 1:2. Remove ALL interface, currency, words, numbers, star symbols, seals, flags/checkpoints, locks, buttons, frame, footer, HUD and circles from the reference. Replace the entire canvas with uninterrupted illustrated world terrain. Absolutely no baked UI anywhere.
Match the reference's clean hand-inked 2D comic fantasy game art, broad flat green and amber areas, navy ink contours, restrained 2-3 shadow tones; avoid hyperrealistic rendering, noisy microtexture and cinematic fog. Elevated overhead 3/4 illustrated overworld map, nearly uniform scale from bottom to top, no sky or horizon.
A single continuous wide pale amber dirt road climbs from lower left near a small blue-roof castle and farm, bends right near a watermill, left over a stone bridge, then snakes upward through a ruined guard post, a timber watchtower and supply huts toward a large blue-roof frontier fortress near upper right. A turquoise creek winds alongside and under the stone bridge. Road must remain clear and wide enough to overlay 10 big interactive pins later; no baked marker bases. Keep generous plain road junctions and terrain clearings. Important road anchor positions expressed as fractions of canvas width/height measured from TOP LEFT: (.28,.91),(.60,.81),(.78,.70),(.50,.61),(.26,.52),(.25,.42),(.64,.34),(.79,.25),(.48,.17),(.70,.075). The road connects these in the listed bottom-to-top order, with smooth natural bends; landmarks to the SIDE of road, not obstructing anchors. The .50,.61 anchor is on the stone bridge, .25,.42 beside watchtower, .70,.075 before fortress gate. Forest clusters frame outer sides; warm sunlit countryside. Fill every edge with terrain, no blank gutters. Original artwork only, no watermark.
prompts.forest:
Use case: style-transfer / game background. Image1 is our production chapter1 background, the EDIT TARGET. Create chapter2 DEEP FOREST as a sibling production game background with EXACT SAME tall 1:2 canvas, camera, uniform map scale and winding road centerline. Preserve the exact road geometry and all traversable clearings: lower-left entry, lower-right curve, center stone-bridge crossing, central-left bend, midleft watchtower bend, midright bend, upper central bend and upperright endpoint. This is needed for interactive markers placed separately by code.
Change the FRONTIER landscape into ancient enchanted forest. Replace both blue-roof castles with old forest gate roots at bottomleft and a giant sacred hollow tree shrine at top right. Replace farms with large ancient tree roots and fern groves, watermill with mossy fallen statue, timber watchtower with a leaning ancient stone watchtower, supply huts with a mossy ruined shrine. Keep the central stone bridge but make it moss-covered and weathered. A calm teal stream stays in same channel. Broad green foliage canopy, turquoise shaded hollows, clear warm ochre trail, purple flower accents, a few scattered ritual standing stones near upper road. Ancient forest sense, no glowing modern magic clutter.
Use same crisp hand-inked comic fantasy, simple chunky shapes, flat color and 2-3 shadow tones, restrained texture; clear readable road. Elevated 3/4 overhead, no sky/horizon, no cinematic fog. Do NOT add any UI, labels, text, numbers, flags, circular platforms, checkpoint pins, characters, borders, logos or watermark. Full bleed environment only, all road anchor areas remain clear. Produce ONE complete production background image.
prompts.lair:
Use case: style-transfer / game background. Image1 is our production chapter1 background, the EDIT TARGET. Create chapter3 BEAST LAIR as a matching production background, EXACT same tall 1:2 canvas and elevated overhead camera, keep the exact winding road geometry and road clearings, the lowerleft entry, lower-right bend, central bridge and upperright end. This sibling terrain must work with the same separately rendered checkpoint pins.
Change countryside to a rugged enemy stronghold: warm gray and brown rocky ravine, hardy olive-green pines on sides, sparse dry ochre grasses, scattered broken stone walls. Replace lowerleft blue castle with broken stone gateway framed by timber stakes, watermill with an abandoned siege wheel, farms with modest ruined animal pens, timber watchtower with crude spiked wooden guard tower, central stone bridge with a broad sturdy rough-stone bridge over a dark teal underground stream. Upperright endpoint becomes an imposing cave entrance carved into a rocky hill, framed by wooden palisades, horn-shaped rock formations and two muted torch fires. One war drum camp beside upper road and a couple of tents near center right. Route color remains warm amber and easy to read, chapter feels dangerous but still daytime legible; muted rust-red cloth accents. No giant monsters, no characters, no bones filling road.
Same polished hand-inked 2D COMIC fantasy as source: broad local colors, chunky ink contours, restrained flat cel shadows, simple silhouettes, no realistic 3D, no painterly microdetail, no heavy fog or black vignette. Preserve road position exactly and leave clear anchor places. Full bleed environment only; no sky, text, symbols, numbers, UI, flags, checkpoints, circular platforms, border, logo or watermark.
